PROPERTIES.clue_custom_text1: There are five office owners. All owners occupy their own office, including the CEO.
PROPERTIES.clue_custom_text2: The CEO may be referred to as both "the CEO" or an "office owner".
PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Let's look at (O)'s clue. He is in the Kitchen either with (A) or (J), but (A) needs to be with an office owner, so she's in an Office. (A) can't be in the Kitchen. This sets (J) on a chair in the Kitchen. (J) is east of three office owners, who are all in separate areas per the general clue. There are exactly three offices to the left of C11, so in order for (J) to be east of them all, (J) must be in the chair in R10 C9.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Per (J)'s clue, this sets one office owner in C8 in Office D. Block the rest of C8. Another office owner west of (J) must be in R4 C7 in Office A. Block the rest of R4 and C7. The third office owner is somewhere in Office C.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Because (M) is alone in the Conference Room, the only chair in R1 for (G) is in Office B. This isolates (G) in R1 C14.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: (L) must be in R16, and not in a chair. The only remaining chairs for (E) are in R13, in Office C or Office D. Block the rest of R13.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en:
(I), in the Hallway and north of exactly one office owner, can't be in R11 or R12, as there would be at least two office owners south of her: the one in Office C and the one in Office D.
This sets (I) in R14 or R15 in the Hallway.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Let's examine R13, R14, R15 and R16. Per (A)'s clue, there's exactly one woman office owner, so that person can't be alone. (E) is either with someone who's the office owner, or she's with (A). There also needs to be another office owner in Office C or Office D, where (E) isn't. So in total, Office C and Office D will hold three people, plus (I), who needs to be in R14 or R15. No one can fit in the CEO's Office in R13 or below.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Per (C)'s clue, two people need to be in the CEO's Office. They're in the two remaining squares. (C), not sitting in a chair, is in R12 C13 and the unknown CEO is in R11 C15.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: Where can (F) be? She can't be one row south of (E). If (E) is an office owner, then (A) would need to also fit in (E)'s area, but (A)(E)(F)(I)(L) can't all fit in R13-R14-R15-R16. Per (J)'s clue, the person in R4 C7 is an office owner. If (F) were in R4 C7, (A) would need to be in R3 C8 beside the trash can, but (A) and (F) can't both be office owners in the same office. (F) must then be in R2, one row south of (G), who's the office owner of Office B. This isolates (F) in the last available R2 square, R2 C10.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: This sets (M) in R3, in the Conference Room. Per (J)'s clue, an office owner is in R4 C7, so (A), who needs to be with the only woman office owner, can't be in R4 C7 herself. This isolates (A) in the only remaining square beside a trashcan inside an Office, R14 C12. (E) must be the office owner in the same area. Per (J)'s clue, she must be west of (J), in R13 C8.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: Per (B)'s clue, she is not with (F) or (K), this isolates (K) in R7 C3. This isolates (M). (L) is then the office owner in Office C. This isolates (L) in R16 C6, and (I) one square north of (L) in R15 C2. This isolates (O) in the last square in the Kitchen.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_11_en: (K) can't be in the Cubicles area per (B)'s clue. This isolates (K) in the last square beside a shelf, R7 C3. This isolates (M) in R3 C4.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_12_en: Where can we place (N)? She cannot be in the Cubicles area, and cannot be in Office A as the owner since (E) is the only woman office owner. This places (N) in R9 C1 in the Front Desk. This isolates (D) in R6 C16 then (B) in R5 C11.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_13_en: (H) cannot be in a column that's adjacent to (D), so he cannot be in C15. This means (H) is in R4 C7, as the office owner of Office A. This isolates (V) as the CEO in R11 C15 with (C). Carter is the murderer!
